Draft runbook (summary):
- Session goals: prompt review, routing policy test, 30-min load at N=50 concurrent streams (approx 120 rpm) with token lengths ~150–300.
- Environment: staging cluster in us-west (can replicate to eu-west1 for EU session).
- Warmup: 10m steady at 15 concurrent to populate KV caches and tokenizers.
- Load: 30m steady at 50 concurrent. Monitor tail p99 and CPU/GPU util.
- Rollback: routing changes will be applied by policy flagging; we will use a canary-based toggle with automatic rollback on latency/error thresholds.
- Networking: please whitelist these static egress IPs: 52.23.18.77, 34.201.12.9 (we'll provide exact range via secure link).
- Data: use anonymized staging dataset; do not send PII to hosted endpoints.
- Contact on-call: dev-patel@redwood.ai (primary), rafael_mendes@redwood.ai (backup).
